attributes.name: Lifesurge Bayonet +1
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d4+1. You may additionally reveal a card that has the Firearm trait to add another 1d4+1. If the bane has the Undead trait, add another 1d8.

Recharge this card to add 1d4+1 to your combat check that has the Firearm trait, or 1d8+1 if the bane has the Undead trait. You may play this card even if you have already played another weapon on this check.

Recharge this card to recharge a random card from your discard pile.
